title: Arithmetic schema demonstration
reviewStatus: Demonstration only — not a course review

objectives.description: Calculate a percentage of a quantity

glossary.Percent: A number of parts out of one hundred.

sourceRefs.locator: Worked example: 20% of 50 = 10; transfer variation: 25% of 80 = 20

variants.concept: Convert the percent to a decimal and multiply by the quantity.
whyWrong: This confuses the percentage with the resulting quantity.

variants.concept: A quarter of a quantity is 25% of it.
whyWrong: This confuses the percentage with the resulting quantity.
